title: BeLyftdCourseSchema
description: JSON Schema for Be Lyft'd youth leadership and personal development courses in the mobile app MVP.

id.description: Unique identifier / slug for the course (e.g. 'behavioral-accountability').

description.description: 2-3 sentence overview highlighting the core purpose, youth context, and outcome of the course.

audioUrl.description: Direct URI to the spoken audio lesson track (MP3 or audio stream).

textContent.description: Comprehensive lesson text structured with Markdown headings, core concepts, reflection questions, and actionable takeaways.

estimatedTime.description: Estimated completion duration for the module (e.g., '5 mins', '7 mins').

isCompleted.description: User progress status flag indicating whether the course module has been completed.
